rule: Fit the plan to the frame on at least four points outside the pools. A pool shows if a person can mark a distinct shadow or tone edge at its place. If fewer than four of the eight show, the method stops. (Results doc, Method 2, fixed before any better frame was opened.)

fit.kind: similarity, least squares on 4 wall corners
fit.cross_check: independent automatic fit of all walls outside the pools (pools and L110 masked) to image darkness: 0.82 m/px, 8 deg, L110 at (29345,19997); differs from the 4-point fit by 1.7-3.5 px at the control points

judgements.L71: shows: dark shadow fills the east side and south end inside the outline, same length and slant
judgements.L56/58: shows: dark shadows inside the L58 outline; L56 part bright with a tone edge
judgements.L91: shows: dark rectangle inside the outline (south part), sharp edges
judgements.L110: shows: dark round spot about 5-6 m across, overlapping the circle, centre about 2 m SE of the fitted centre
judgements.L48/49: possible: dark elongated shadow overlapping the NE half of the outline, centre offset about 3 m NE
judgements.L117: possible: dark shadow of the same shape and slant along the SE edge of the outline, offset about 2 m
judgements.L118: possible: dark shadow of the same size just east of the outline, offset about 2.5-3 m
judgements.L138: does not show: no distinct shadow or edge; texture like the surrounding ground

verdict: 4 of 8 show (up to 7 with the possibles): at least four, so the method does not stop for this film
exposure: The judge (Claude) had seen the 4-point and automatic overlays before marking; the clean crop with ticks (judge_clean.png) is kept for an independent marking by a person who has not seen the overlay.
ground_px_m: 0.82 m per pixel from the fit (plan scale); up is about 9 deg from the Fig. 9 north arrow
